name: @avatark/living-echo
description: Shared contract for Living Echo -- PrometheusK's own recorded trace of a person's practice over time, produced only there and never duplicated (see docs/PLATFORM_CONTRACTS.md). This package defines the shape every other product reads/embeds, not a second implementation. No Supabase, no API, no product-specific logic.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
